verdict.rationale: telli is an AI voice-agent platform, so grounding agents on your own documents is a fair question to ask of it. The pack, however, shows no built-in knowledge base, document upload, or RAG feature. The closest items are custom tools that call your APIs and a web_search tool for public information, and neither is document grounding. At most you could build your own retrieval API and expose it as a custom tool, but nothing in the pack documents that use.
